: Model 2: profile composition, verified records, and circulation families {#tbl-model2}

*Note.* Selected coefficients; dependent variable: log posted USD hourly rate; N = 352,986 throughout. Omitted composition: authored-generic share. All forms include country and first-listed-occupation effects, completed-job groups, log(1 + jobs), log(1 + hours), rating bands, a five-degree-of-freedom description-age spline, agency membership, occupation count, log description characters, and log qualifying-sentence count. Forms 2a/2b have country-clustered SEs. Form 2c has model-based SEs and ML city and sharer-only family random effects. In 2b/2c, composition main effects refer to zero jobs; shared-share interactions shift both shared categories equally. ML SEs are not country-clustered.
